_comment: LLM router (H-012), docs/router.md. Callers declare a tier; this table decides the backend. Read again on every request: a change here needs no restart. backend: local (the F-017 model on this box) or claude (the claude CLI, Pro subscription; never an API key). on_failure: fail (return the error) or escalate (try the other backend once; the log shows it). default_backend: what a caller would use without the router; a request the local backend answers on a tier whose baseline (default_backend, or the optional per-tier "baseline") is claude counts as a Claude run avoided.
